summary: LZ Technology Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of a Class B meeting and extraordinary general meeting held on May 6, 2026. Shareholders approved a special resolution increasing voting rights of Class A ordinary shares from 10 votes per share to 300 votes per share, and an ordinary resolution to increase authorized share capital from $50,000 to $2,000,000. No price, premium, or acquisition terms are present; the filing covers routine corporate governance amendments. This is not a special situation—it is a standard foreign private issuer report on shareholder votes.
